patches.old_text: Stripe Entitlements is a feature-gating layer built into Stripe Billing. It lets you map internal product features to Stripe Products so that Stripe automatically tracks which customers should have access to which capabilities based on their active subscription status — without custom database tables or manual provisioning logic.
patches.new_text: Stripe Entitlements is a feature-gating layer built into Stripe Billing. In the 2026-05-13 guide, mapping internal product features to Stripe Products lets Stripe track customer entitlements through subscriptions; the application still handles provisioning and de-provisioning from entitlement signals.
patches.reason: Correct the existing no-manual-provisioning overstatement while dating the guide.

patches.old_text: | `entitlements.active_entitlement_summary` | The full entitlement snapshot for a customer; returned in webhook payloads and the polling API. |
patches.new_text: | `entitlements.active_entitlement_summary` | Customer entitlement summary in the webhook payload. Its `entitlements.data` array holds at most 10 items; use `entitlements.url` for the complete paginated list when the customer has more than 10 active entitlements. |
patches.reason: Remove the unqualified full-snapshot claim contradicted by the old guide's 10-item cap.

patches.old_text:
5. **Grant**: feature present in `entitlements.data` → enable access
6. **Revoke**: feature absent from `entitlements.data` → disable access
patches.new_text:
5. **Grant**: enable a feature listed in `entitlements.data`
6. **Revoke**: before disabling a feature absent from `entitlements.data`, reconcile against the complete active-entitlement list when the summary may be truncated; for a customer with more than 10 entitlements, fetch all pages through `entitlements.url`
patches.reason: Prevent revocation based solely on absence from a capped summary.

patches.old_text: Fires whenever a customer's entitlements change (subscribe, upgrade, downgrade, cancel). Payload is the full current entitlement state.
patches.new_text: In the 2026-05-13 API guide, this event signals entitlement changes through subscriptions. The payload gives a current summary; `entitlements.data` can omit active features when the customer has more than 10 entitlements, so fetch the complete paginated list before absence-based revocation.
patches.reason: Qualify the second full-state claim at the webhook section.
